title: Only a platform admin can adopt a Space into the Business Seeder (LIVE-1211)
detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. PREMISE RE-TESTED: adoptSpaceMasterProfile gated only on structure:write, so any such staff member could adopt any Space by id and then re-seed it, around the admin-only intent of searchActiveSpaces (admin or janitor). It now takes the same web_role gate and returns a plain refusal otherwise.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/admin/business-seeder/actions.ts','utf8');const i=s.indexOf('export async function adoptSpaceMasterProfile');const body=s.slice(i,i+1400);if(!/webRole !== 'admin' && caller\?\.webRole !== 'janitor'/.test(body)){console.error('LIVE-1211: adoptSpaceMasterProfile has no admin or janitor gate');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when adopt loses its platform-admin gate.
